manifest.notes: VisualIdentity.md, Edition 1: a community proposal for IMD's visual identity, decided by identity.md seat holders. LaunchToken (VIMD) is the standard fixed-supply launch token with no constructor arguments. FinalistArtA, FinalistArtB and FinalistArtC are immutable, argument-free contracts that each return one finalist's logomark SVG exactly as published under art/finalist-a, -b and -c. BrandGenesisNFT is the ERC-721 'Visual Identity Genesis' (VIMDG); its constructor takes, in order, this launch's token ($token) as the VIMD burned by mint(uint8), the identity.md seat collection on Ethereum mainnet (0x0000ec93127baa929e58e97dd0095a2bfb38ec1d, an address-typed argument fixed by the approved workflow) whose ownerOf gates vote(uint256,uint8), and the three finalist art contracts ($contract:FinalistArtA, B and C) as the tokenURI image sources. The constructor stores these addresses and sets VOTE_END to deployment plus 7 days; it calls no other contract, so it runs on an empty chain. BrandGenesisNFT has no owner, admin, pause, upgrade, setter or withdraw function, so no constructor argument grants a privileged role and $owner is not used anywhere in this launch. No contract here is allocated, reserved or sent any of the supply; the factory splits it (the swarm's 10% to the MerkleDistributor, 90% to the pool). Burn mints transfer 50,000 VIMD from the caller to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD; that address is a burn sink inside mint(uint8), never a constructor argument. The pool pairs VIMD with IMD at the launch policy's 1.25% fee, tick spacing 60; the deployer derives the opening price from the policy's opening market cap, so initialPrice is written as the launch facts give it.
